name: Product scope
description: Asset product must be one of the signal's products. Scope only: never creates an exposure on its own

name: Resource type scope
description: Asset resource type must be one of the signal's resource types. Scope only

name: Environment type scope
description: Asset environment type must be one of the signal's environment types. Scope only

name: Harness scope
description: Agent harness must match. Scope only

name: Connector join
description: Asset uses one of the signal's connectors

name: Capability join
description: Asset has one of the signal's capabilities

name: Auth mode join
description: Asset runs under one of the signal's auth modes

name: Tenant setting check
description: Exposure when the tenant lacks the setting (or it doesn't cover the signal's products). Not an asset match

name: Model join
description: Asset uses the model the signal names (canonical id from the model vocabulary, ADR 0013)
